answer: An hostile operator running 14 aliases therefore needs 44 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in walnut, expire in forge, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 194 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
